description: This class, ContentFiles, is a data transfer object used within a Java web application to handle content file uploads. It encapsulates a list of uploaded files and associated metadata like filename, serving as a form backing bean for the admin interface in a Spring-based application.

classes.name: ContentFiles
classes.description: A bean class for handling content file uploads in the admin panel, supporting validation and serialization.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the list of MultipartFile objects representing uploaded files.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves the list of uploaded MultipartFile objects.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename associated with the uploaded content.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename associated with the upload.
